device.title: Extra Controls — {device_name}
device.description: Select which entities to expose for {device_name}. Only enable options your device supports — unsupported settings will be silently ignored by the appliance.

data_description.check_filter: Problem sensor that turns on when the filter state is CLEAN, CHANGE, or BUY. Use it to trigger filter-maintenance notifications.
data_description.filter_runtime: Cumulative air-filter runtime reported by the appliance, exposed in hours.
data_description.active_alerts: Problem sensor that turns on when the appliance reports one or more active fault codes.
data_description.compressor: Estimated from ambient and target temperatures because the Frigidaire API does not expose compressor state.
data_description.current_fan_speed: Fan-speed state reported by the appliance. It can resolve AUTO to a speed but may persist while the appliance is off; it is not proof the fan is running.
data_description.cool_hysteresis: Temperature deadband around the setpoint used when estimating whether the compressor is running (drives the cooling/idle status). 0 disables the deadband.
data_description.compressor_off_delay: How long the room must stay below the setpoint before the status flips from cooling to idle. Models compressor run-on and avoids flapping near the setpoint.

error.no_appliances: No Frigidaire appliances found on this account.
